feat(account): 实现微软账号皮肤与披风管理功能

fix: 修复皮肤管理相关的问题并移除 AuthInfo 的 AutoCloseable 实现

- 微软账户皮肤/披风 API 调用前先经 logIn() 校验并刷新 token，避免登录超 24 小时后 401 失败
- 离线皮肤对话框未选择文件时保存 DEFAULT 类型，避免误触发 authlib-injector 导致离线环境无法启动游戏
- 披风列表过滤校验失败的 null 元素，防止构建列表时 NPE
- 皮肤重置增加确认弹窗，并修正重置文案与中文翻译（仅涉及皮肤，不含披风）
- Skin.Type.fromStorage 恢复对未知类型回退 DEFAULT 的旧行为，避免存量数据被静默替换为 Steve
- 移除 Skin.java 中无引用的 FetchBytesTask 与 SkinJson 死代码
- 移除 AuthInfo 的 AutoCloseable 实现及子类的 close() 覆写（代码中无任何调用点）
- gradlew 设为可执行

refactor(trust-ui): render the trust dialog as labelled rows, not one text blob

Every fact was concatenated into a single scrolling FCLTextView with the labels
baked into the format strings ("Plugin: %1$s\nVersion: %2$s\nType: %3$s"). Nine
or more facts arrived as one wall of prose with no hierarchy, nothing to scan
by, and a fingerprint wrapped mid-run at 16 characters.

Facts are now structured data. PluginTrustGate hands the dialog sections of
label/value pairs and the dialog inflates a view per row, so a heading is
something the launcher draws and a value is something a plugin supplies - never
the same view. Each row is bounded, so no supplied string can grow the dialog or
push a later row out of sight, which is what the sanitiser and the section
reordering were compensating for before. The registered-publisher section is
emitted only when the signed list actually names a publisher, so its presence is
itself a claim a plugin cannot fabricate.

The fingerprint gets the full width in a fixed-pitch face, grouped in fours and
wrapped every 32 characters, so two of them can be compared by eye.

Sections use a themed heading and a hairline rule rather than filled cards:
bg_container_white is a hardcoded white and would invert badly in dark mode,
while FCLView's use_theme_color follows the active theme.

Drops five composite format strings from both locales in favour of thirteen
label and heading strings.
